title: nan
authors: Shen C.; Zhao Z.; Yan D.; Ling Y.
key_contribution: Presents a vehicle-road cooperative positioning method fusing roadside sensing infrastructure with vehicle dead reckoning in complex GNSS-denied urban environments.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Hybrid_Classical_Learning to ensure precise positioning.
